text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah... the scent of snow!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Snow? Where, where!?
The forecast said it'd be sunny, didn't it??

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Umm~, that's true, but...
I think from now on—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaah!? It actually snowed!?
Yuki-chan, you're amaaaaazing!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, since I grew up surrounded by snow,
I kind of just ended up knowing these things...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Back in the day, we'd head home before the snow started falling, and once it stopped, everyone would shovel it together.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Build a big snow igloo, look up at the beautiful starry sky, and—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Waah~!
The snow and the stars are all so sparkly~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Mother
text_block_list.text: "Fufu. Yuki-chan, you're just as much of a beauty yourself, you know."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Father
text_block_list.text: Yep, yep! A girl this pretty is definitely gonna be a "City Girl"!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Dad, Mom...
...I wonder how everyone's doing.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I got a great idea!
Let's build an igloo too!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Allllriiiight!!
Let's gather tons of snooooow!!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
T-Ticket-saaaan!
Wait for meee...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Heave, ho...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Alright, keep 'em coming!
Right, don't stop now!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Allllriiiight!!
The snow hut is fiiiinished--!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...! There's less snow over here, so this is about the best I can do, but...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wait, did a blizzard just suddenly start!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah...!
Let's take shelter in the snow hut...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Phew, thank goodness~
The blizzard has completely stopped, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Night skyyyy!!
Thank you for clearing uuup!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Just like you said, Yuki-chan, it's so, sooo gorgeousssss!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You're right... The sky, and Ticket-san...
...they're both so freakin' dazzling.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Dad, Mom.
There's not much snow here, and you can barely see the stars.
...Sometimes I kinda miss Morioka.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Bu-ut, all around me, I've got friends
who shine bright and dazzling like stars!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(So, I'm okay!
I'll keep giving it my all right here...!)
